name: MN Softwares NP Fake Share
author: Dipesh Kumar Kushwaha

sections.description:
MN Softwares NP Fake Share displays only a share number (no social icons) and increases it using view-based random logic.
Includes:
* View-based random increment logic
* Anti-refresh lock using transients
* Manual share base metabox
* Shortcode [mnfsc_fake_share_count]
* Optional auto append to single posts
* Count formatting (K, M, B)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Optional: Enable auto display in Settings > MN Fake Share Count
  4. Or use shortcode: [mnfsc_fake_share_count]
sections.faq:
Does it show social icons?

No. Only a number like “1.5K Shares”.

Can I set the share count manually?

Yes. Edit a post and use the “Manual Share Count” metabox.
